The '''Outcast village''' was a section of the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] where [[Outcasts (Taris)|Outcasts]] from the [[Upper City]] and their descendants resided. The village was surrounded by walls to protect the residents from the [[rakghoul]]s which roamed the Undercity. In [[3956 BBY]], [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Carth Onasi]] arrived in the Undercity [[Rescue of Bastila Shan|looking for]] [[Bastila Shan]]. Although never seen, [[Zelka Forn]] had a second medical facility in the village, which would eventually have vials of [[Rakghoul serum]].

{{GameLS}}
The village was vacated by the Outcasts when Revan provided the residents with journals indicating the fabled [[Promised Land]] and was presumably destroyed by the [[Destruction of Taris|orbital bombardment]] at the hands of [[Darth Malak]].

Over three centuries later, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] would find the ruins of the village and recover a Rakghoul serum vial, which was later improved and duplicated by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] scientist and become owned by the Republic. The village like the rest of the planet, fell to the occupation of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]].
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the non-canon dark-side ending, if Revan gives the journals to [[Igear]] for destruction, the Outcasts remain in the village.
